Commentary.Commentary: Now, 340 is a very good score but the wicket is looking really good for batting and the Australian openers showed what they are capable of when they chased down 256 inside 38 overs in the first ODI. One might say that the Indian bowling was slightly off-color in that game and they would look to turn things around here in Rajkot. Interesting to see how the run chase pans out.

Shikhar Dhawan is caught for a quick chat. He starts by saying that he did not know that he was on 96 but he is happy with how he and Kohli batted. Praises Rahul for ending the innings well. Adds that they needed to attack the bowlers and that's what they did. Goes onto say that Rahul showed great composure and calmness. On the pitch, Dhawan goes onto say that it is a good wicket and they need to bowl right lines and lengths. Finishes by saying they have added an extra pacer and it is going to be a different ball game altogether.

As far as the Australian bowling is concerned, it looked really off color at the start with Starc and Richardson going for runs. It was Adam Zampa who provided the breakthrough for the Aussies when he removed Rohit Sharma in the 14th over of the innings. He kept bowling tight lines and length from his end and did not allow Indians to score briskly. He finished with a 3-fer and once again dismissed Virat Kohli. However, he did not get enough support from the other end and the Indians managed to build a few good partnerships. The hosts slammed 91 runs in the final 10 overs that is good enough to describe how things panned out in the death overs for them. Although they will be disappointed not to cross the 350-run hurdle.

A tight final over from Mitchell Starc but India would feel happy with the total they have put on the board after being asked to set the target. They started really well with Rohit and Dhawan adding 81 runs for the opening wicket. Indian skipper joined Dhawan out in the middle and both took the team to an even better position as they added 103 runs between them. Dhawan fell just 4 short of a well-deserved ton. Kohli raked up his half ton and added 78 runs with KL Rahul to propel India. Australia bounced back with quick wickets but KL Rahul with his brilliant 52-ball 80 took India to 340.
Short ball outside off, Jadeja punches it to the cover region and takes a single. Brilliant last over for Australia. Only 5 runs have come from it. INDIA END ON 340/6.
Yorker on off, Shami looks to dig it out but gets an inside edge which goes towards the leg side. The batters take a single.
Mohammed Shami walks in next. 2 balls left.

OUT! RUN OUT! Rahul has to depart after playing a terrific innings. He does not even wait for the umpire's decision and starts walking. Short ball on middle, Jadeja backs away and then looks to pull but misses. Rahul wants the bye and takes off. Carey collects and has a shy at the stumps. He hits. The third umpire is called and the replays show that even the dive did not save Rahul as he is way short of the crease.

Is KL Rahul struggling? He thinks so as he keeps walking. He wanted to steal a bye but Carey hit the stumps with his under arm throw. The third umpire has been called for and the replays show that he is short.
BYE! Short ball down the leg side, Rahul makes room for himself and looks to pull but misses. The batters manage to take a bye.
Short ball on middle, Ravindra pulls it but finds the deep mid-wicket fielder. Only a single.
EDGY BUT SAFE! Good length ball on off, Rahul looks to heave it away to the leg side but gets a top edge. It lands in no man's land and the batters take a single.
Short ball on middle, Rahul works it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Excellent batting! Full delivery on middle,, Rahul flicks it nicely to the fine leg region. Agar comes across, slides but is unable to stop the ball from reaching the fence.
SIX! Nicely played! Another short one outside off, Rahul makes room and plays it uppishly over the point fielder for a biggie.
Play and a miss! Short delivery on middle, Rahul looks to heave it away but fails to get any bat on it.
Short delivery outside off, Rahul swats it towards deep square leg and takes a couple.
Back of a length ball on middle, Jadeja makes room and then pushes it to cover for a single.
Pat Cummins to bowl the penultimate over of the innings. 9-1-9-39-0 from him so far.
Full toss on the pads, Jadeja misses out as he flicks it to fine leg for a single. 11 runs have come from this over.
Short ball on middle, Rahul pulls it to fine leg for a single.
Fullish on middle, Jadeja works it to mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Length ball down the leg side, Jadeja lets it go to the keeper. It is wided. Rahul wants to steal the bye but Rahul says no.
Full toss on middle, Jadeja looks to flick but it goes off the inside half of the bat to deep mid-wicket for a couple before the fielder can come across and clean it up.
Back of a length ball on off, Rahul taps it to the deep point region for a single.
FOUR! That is some shot from KL Rahul! Good length ball outside off, Rahul guides it past the point fielder for a boundary. Good start to the over for India. 1000 runs for Rahul in ODIs.
Full delivery on middle and leg, Jadeja times his flick perfectly towards deep square leg and calls Rahul for a couple. Richardson is done for the day. He finishes with 10-0-73-2.
Another slower one, this one is full on off, Rahul taps it to point for a single.
Shorter on off, Jadeja stands tall and pulls it to deep square leg. Only a single.
Slower short ball on off, Rahul waits for it and then pulls it to the deep mid-wicket region for a single.
Fullish on off, Jadeja drives it to long off for a single.

Slower delivery on middle, Jadeja flicks it to deep square leg region. The fielder comes across and throws it to the keeper but Jadeja is quick and manages to come back for the second. Jadeja is warned again for running on the pitch.
Short delivery around the leg stump line, Jadeja pulls it to fine leg for a single
Short delivery on middle, Rahul pulls it to the leg side for a single.
Full delivery down the leg side, Rahul lets it go to the keeper. Wide signaled.
SIX! Sensational batting! Not easy to hit these balls and Rahul has done it with ease. Full delivery outside off, Rahul nonchalantly lifts this over the extra cover region for a biggie.
FOUR! Nicely played from Rahul! 6th  Fifty for KL Rahul! Low full toss outside off, Rahul hammers it through the cover region. The fielder comes across and dives the ball goes onto touch the ropes.
Short of a length ball on middle, Jadeja looks to defend but gets hit on the gloves and then it rolls to the point region. The batters take a single.
Full delivery outside off, Rahul drives it to deep cover for a single.
Mitchell Starc is back into the attack. 7-0-48-0 are his figures.
Fullish delivery on off, Rahul drives it to cover and takes a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the keeper's end but misses. Jadeja was in though.
Outside off, Jadeja cuts it to the deep point region for a single.
Back of a length ball on off, Jadeja pushes it to the point region. Jadeja wants the single but is sent back. He has been warned to not run on the pitch as well by the umpire.
FOUR! Gets off the mark with a boundary. Good length ball down the leg side, Jadeja just helps it on its way to the fine leg region for a boundary.
Short delivery outside off, Rahul pushes it to point and crosses over for a single.
Local lad Ravindra Jadeja comes in now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust and India are struggling yet again in the death overs. Richardson gets his second. Short of a length ball on off, Pandey looks to pull but does not get any timing on it. It lobs up way in the air towards deep mid-wicket. Ashton Agar runs in from deep mid-wicket and takes a simple catch.
On the pads again, this time Pandy works it behind square leg for a single. Agar finishes with 50/3 in his 10 overs.
Full and around off, Rahul tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full and around off, pushed to mid off for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Shortish ball on middle, Rahul works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Manish Pandey replaces his skipper out in the middle.
Australia have got the massive wicket of Virat Kohli in time. They will now look to restrict the Indians to as smaller a total as possible. Interesting few overs coming up.

OUT! Caught! Brilliant stuff from Agar and Australia have got the big fish.  A floated ball on middle, Kohli looks to smash it over the bowler's head for a maximum. He does not time it too well and gets more height than the distance. Agar from long off runs across, keeps his eyes on the ball and pouches it well. He though feels that the momentum will take him over the ropes so he throws the ball towards Starc who comes from long on. Starc does not make any mistake there and pouches it to safety. The umpires get together and refer the decision upstairs. After checking multiple replays it is clear that this is a clean catch which means Kohli will have to keep walking. End of a very good hand from the Indian skipper but the Aussies would be really happy seeing his back.
Adam Zampa to bowl out.
Full delivery on off, Kohli defends it to cover and crosses over for a single.
Short delivery on middle, Rahul pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Good length ball on off, Rahul makes room and then slides it towards the deep cover region for a couple.

What happened there? Good length ball down the pads, Rahul looks to play the paddle scoop but gets hit on the thigh pad. He does not know where the ball is and then sees the ball is rolling towards the stumps and pushes it away.
Slower short one on off, Kohli pulls it to long on for another run.
Short of a length ball outside off, Rahul punches it to deep cover and collects a single.

Floated on middle, Kohli whips it to the deep mid-wicket region and calls Rahul for a couple. Brilliant running. 13 runs from the over.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Nicely fielded! Short of a length ball on off, Rahul cuts it to deep point where Labuschagne comes across and makes a good sliding stop. The batters take two.
SIX! Thrashed! Agar tosses this one up on leg, Rahul hammers it over the bowler's head for a biggie.
On middle, Kohli punches this down to long and picks up another single.
Floated on middle and leg, Rahul works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Ashton Agar is back on. 7-0-50-0 from him so far.
Full and outside off, Rahul eases a single through mid off. 8 from the over.
On the pads, it is worked behind square leg for a single.
FOUR! Slammed! Full and outside off, Kohli gets in the position and slogs it using his bottom hands. The ball goes to the deep mid-wicket fence all along the ground.
Quicker one on middle, Rahul works it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Floats it on off, Rahul looks to defend but the ball takes the inside edge onto the pads.
Full and on middle, Kohli pushes it to long on for a single. 250 up for India with that run.

FOUR! Nicely done! 50-run stand is up between the two as well. A short of a length ball on the hips, Rahul swivels and pulls it to the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
Good length ball angled into the batsman. Kohli works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On off on a shortish length, tapped through covers for a single.
Around off, this time Kohli pushes it to deep point for a single.

Run out chance goes abegging! A direct hit was needed. Short of a length ball around off, Kohli taps it towards point and then thinks off a single. Rahul takes off from the other end but Kohli quickly says no. Smith picks the ball and throws it towards the bowler but the throw is not a good one and Rahul returns safely.
Full and on middle, Rahul whips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Kohli had missed out a couple of balls earlier but Rahul takes full toll to this short and wide delivery outside off. He goes on the back foot and slams it through point for a boundary.
Full and on middle, it is eases for a single through mid on.
Short and wide outside off, Kohli looks to cut off his back foot but misses.
Slightly short and on off, Rahul taps it through cover-point for a single.

Around off on a length, Rahul taps it to point.
A back of a length ball on middle, Kohli pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
That kept low! Both the bowler and the batsman exchange smiles. A good length ball outside off, Kohli looks to defend but the ball goes to to the keeper under his bat.

Length ball around off, Rahul defends it off the back foot. 9 from Cummins 8th over.

FOUR! Through the off side this time. Brilliant batting. Cummins once again bowls it full and just outside off, Kohli creams it through the extra cover region for another boundary. That looked really classy.
FOUR! Whipped! Full and outside off, Kohli moves towards the off side and whips it to mid-wicket using his wrists. No chance for anyone there.

Full and around off, it is defended.

FIFTY UP FOR THE INDIAN SKIPPER! 56th half ton in the ODIs. A very calm and composed innings from him so far and he would look to score a big one. He gets there by nudging this full ball on the stumps towards long on. He failed  in the first ODI but one cannot keep the best batsman in the world quite for too long.
On the pads, it is worked behind square leg for a single.

Length ball on the pads, Rahul works it back to the bowler.

FOUR! Full and outside off, Rahul leans into the drive and creams it through the covers to bag his first boundary. 200 up for the Indians with this boundary.
On the pads, Rahul works it towards square leg for a single to get off the mark.
On off, Rahul pushes it towards covers.
KL Rahul walks in next.

UNDER-19 WORLD CUP UPDATE - Yes, that tournament is going on as well. In fact, it kicked off at the same time when Pat Cummins was charging in to bowl the first over of the match today. Hosts South Africa are taking on Afghanistan and please, brace yourselves. Because the Afghans have bundled the Proteas out for a paltry 129! Well, this is going to be a shocker for many...

Drinks! Australia are making a good little comeback here. After a brilliant partnership between Dhawan and Kohli, the Aussies have managed to pick up two quick wickets and now they would be looking to restrict the Indians. The hosts now would depend on Kohli to stay out there and get them to a huge score as this looks like a pretty flat track.

The ball goes, kisses the pads and then goes behind to shatter the stumps. A needless shot from Iyer and he will be gutted as he trudges off. Zampa has his second wicket.

Bangs it short and outside off, Iyer guides it towards point.

Fuller and outside off, Kohli strokes it to mid off.
Starc starts the new spell with a ball on the pads, Kohli nudges it behind square leg and scampers back for a couple.
Mitchell Starc is back on. 5-0-33-0, his figures so far.
Good length ball around off, Iyer taps it towards the off side and thinks off a run but Kohli says a loud no.
Back of a length ball on middle, Iyer sways away from it.
FOUR! This time he hammers the short ball. Richardson bangs it short and outside off, Iyer waits on the back foot and then drags the pull to the deep mid-wicket fence.
A slower bouncer, it is outside off. Iyer lets it be.
Driven nicely! Overpitched and outside off, Iyer drives it through the covers and wide of the sweeper in the deep. A couple of runs taken.
Shortish ball just outside off, Kohli taps it to third man off the back foot for a single.
Floated on off, Iyer punches it to cover. Good over from Zampa as only three runs have come from it.
Flighted one on middle, Kohli works it to the leg side for another single.
Floated on off, Iyer taps it to the cover region and takes a single to get off the mark.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Just short! Very lucky is Shreyas Iyer! Floated ball on middle, Iyer looks to push but does so uppishly. Zampa though is late in getting down and the ball falls just short of him.
Floated one on off, Kohli drives it to deep cover for a single.
Adam Zampa returns. 5-0-28-1 are his numbers so far.
Length ball on middle, Iyer defends it to the leg side.
BOUNCER! It is bowled around off, Iyer sways away from it.
No KL Rahul at no 4 then. It is Shreyas Iyer who walks in next to join skipper out in the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! What happened there? Richardson is surprised as to how he managed to get that wicket. It is a pretty innocuous delivery really and it should have been put away. Short delivery down the leg side. Dhawan pulls it but finds Mitchell Starc to perfection at fine leg. Kohli looks disappointed as he shakes his head at the non-strikers head. Dhawan has to go after playing a majestic 96 and deserved a ton.
SIX! Hammered! Slower one on middle, Dhawan waits for it and thrashes it over the bowler's head for a biggie. 100-run partnership is between the two.

Short delivery outside off, Richardson punches it through covers for a couple.
Bowling change! Kane Richardson is back on. 4-0-30-0 from him so far.

FOUR! Ruins a good over! Only 3 had come from the first 5 balls and this has made it 7. Full delivery down the leg side, Dhawan moves into the 90s by just helping it on its way to the fine leg region for a boundary.
Loopy delivery on off, Kohli drives it down to long off for a single.
Short ball on middle, Dhawan pulls it uppishly and it lands in front of the deep mid-wicket fielder. A single taken.
Low full toss on middle, Dhawan flicks it to mid-wicket.
Full toss on middle, Dhawan pushes it back to the bowler.
Good delivery! Floats this one up on off, Dhawan comes down the track and looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.

Stifled appeal from the bowler but nothing from the umpire. Lands around off , Dhawan looks to defend but the ball hits the inner half of the bat. Agar makes an appeal but nothing from the umpire.
FOUR! A dragged down one from Agar, Dhawan rocks back and pulls it to the deep square leg fence. Poor ball from Agar and Dhawan is in good rhythm to miss out on these.
SIX! Massive! First biggie of the game. A loopy ball on middle, Dhawan comes down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and hammers it over deep mid-wicket for half a dozen.
Full and outside off, Dhawan skips down the track and pushes it to mid off.
Around off on a shortish length, Kohli runs it down to short third man gently and takes a quick run.

Flatter one on middle, Dhawan is quick to get his bat down in time and does so towards cover. There is an appeal for LBW but the umpire shakes his head. 8 runs have come off Labuschagne's first. Probably, they felt that it was pad first and then the pad.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground. They pick up a single.
Short delivery on middle, Dhawan pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy delivery on middle, Kohli works it towards deep square leg for a single.

OHH! Just over. Floated on off, Dhawan looks to drive but takes the bottom half of the bat and goes uppishly towards the bowler. Marnus jumps but it goes over and the ball rolls towards long off. A single taken.
FOUR! Welcome into the attack, Mr. Labuschagne! Short ball outside off, Dhawan cuts it nicely through the point region for a boundary.
Part-timer, Marnus Labuschagne, is into the attack now.
Short of a length ball on middle, Dhawan works it to the leg side to keep strike for the next over.
FOUR! Reverse sweep this time from Dhawan! Flighted on middle, Dhawan revers sweeps this one down to the third man region to pick up another boundary.
FOUR! Swept away nicely. Floated on middle, Dhawan bends on his knee and slog sweeps it in between the deep mid-wicket and deep square leg fielder for a boundary.

Flatter one on middle, Kohli stands tall and defends it back to the bowler.
Full delivery on middle, Kohli pushes it back to Agar.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Dhawan works it to mid-wicket for nothing.
Full delivery on the pads, Dhawan plays the pick-up shot towards deep mid-wicket. Labuschagne from deep square leg runs across and gets to the ball on the bounce. Two taken.
BOUNCER! It is bowled around middle and leg, Dhawan sways away from it. Given one for the over.
Good length ball on off, Dhawan pushes it down to mid off.
Short ball down the leg side, Dhawan looks to pull but misses. It is wided by the umpire.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full delivery down the leg side, Dhawan flicks the ball and it rolls wide of Carey. The batters steal a single.
Loopy delivery on middle, SD works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floated one on the pads, Dhawan looks to flick bu8t misses to get hit on the pads.
On middle, punched down to long on for another run.
Loopy delivery on middle, Dhawan works it to the leg side for a single.
Flat one on off, Kohli punches it to long off for a single.
Flatter one on the pads, Dhawan flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Full delivery on the pads, Dhawan flicks it to fine leg for a single. 50-run stand is up between the two.

EDGY FOUR! Just wide of the keeper. Short delivery outside off, Dhawan looks to cut but gets an outside edge. Carey behind the wickets sticks his left hand out to catch but the ball evades him and goes to the third man fence.
On the pads, Kohli flicks it to fine leg for a single.
Short of a length ball outside off, Kohli punches it to cover off the back foot.

FIFTY! 29th one for Dhawan in ODIs. Back-to-back in this series. He missed out on a hundred in the previous game but can he convert it here? He gets to the milestone by pushing this length ball to cover and taking a single.
Starc starts with a good length ball on the pads, Kohli whips it to fine leg for a single.
Mitchell Starc returns. 3-0-20-0 from him so far.

Agar starts with a flatter one on off, Dhawan defends it out.
Ashton Agar comes into the attack now.
Loopy delivery on middle, Kohli defends it back to the bowler. 8 runs have come from the over.
Flighted ball on off, Dhawan dances down the track and drives it to long off for another single.
Floated on off, Kohli pushes it to deep cover and crosses over for a single.
FOUR! Short of a length from Zampa. Kohli rocks on his back foot and then pulls it to the backward square leg region for a boundary.
Floated on off, Shikhar pushes it to the cover region and takes a single.

Floated on off, Kohli prods forward and drives it through covers. Labuschagne runs across from deep point, slides and makes the stop. The batters only take two. The umpires check whether Marnus has managed to clean it clearly and the replays show that it is.

Drinks! India have started well. Australia won't be unhappy too as they got rid of dangerous Rohit just before this mini-break. However, Shikhar Dhawan is still out there and is looking really good. The Indian skipper has just joined him out in the middle at his regular no. 3 batting position and would look to build another stand. The Aussies, on the other hand, would look to keep chipping away at wickets and have the scoring rate under check. Interesting second hour awaits.
On middle, Dhawan solidly defends it to the cover fielder.
BOUNCER! It is bowled around middle and leg, Dhawan ducks under it.

Length ball just outside off, Kohli moves a hint to the offside and keeps it out.

Pat Cummins is back on. 5-1-20-0 from him so far. A slip in place for him.
Loopy one on middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Floated on middle, Kohli drives it to deep cover to get off the mark for a single.
The crowd roars as they see the Indian skipper, Virat Kohli, walking out to the middle at his regular no. 3 spot.

OUT! LBW! All reds and a waste of a review from Sharma and India. This is a big, big wicket as Rohit can be dangerous and he had just started to get going. Floated ball from Zampa on off, Sharma looks to sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. He falls on the ground in the process. Zampa and the rest appeal for LBW and the umpire agrees with them as he raises the finger. Rohit does not look happy and after discussing with Dhawan, he goes for the review. The Ultra Edge rolls in and it confirms there is no bat on it. The Ball Tracker rolls in and it shows that it is pitching in line and going on to hit the middle stump. The Hitman has to go and takes the only review with him. He was just 4 runs away from reaching the 9000-run mark in ODIs.

Rohit has been given out but he has taken the decision upstairs. That looked really close. He had a long chat with his partner and then took the call. The Ultra Edge arrives a little late but it does and shows that there's no bat. Now, the Ball Tracker, three reds it is as the ball is hitting the middle stump. Rohit has to go and he takes the lone review with him too.
FOUR! Rohit Sharma has started to make a move on now. Floated on off, Sharma lunges and sweeps it towards the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Full delivery on middle, Dhawan drives it past the bowler and towards long off for a single.
Good length ball on off, Rohit taps it to point for nothing.
On a length on middle and leg, Dhawan flicks it to backward square leg and collects a single.
Length ball on middle, Sharma whips it to square leg for a single.
FOUR! Slapped! This is Rohit Sharma at his best. Short delivery outside off, Sharma dances down and swats it towards the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Short ball on the pads, Dhawan looks to pull but misses to get hit on the thigh pad. The ball rolls to the leg side and the batters steal a leg bye.
Short and outside off, Rohit waits on the back foot and runs it down to third man for a run.
On the pads, Rohit works it towards short third man and takes a quick single.  4 from Zampa's first over.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and around off, SD guides it towards point and takes a single.
Hit very hard but on the stumps at the non-striker's end. A full ball around off, Dhawan drills it straight down the ground but demolishes the stumps. That would've been a certain boundary.
Misfield and a run. Full and around off, Rohit pushes it towards mid off where the fielder misfields and allows a single.
Fires it on the stumps, it is pushed towards mid on.
WIDE! Zampa starts with a full toss on the pads, Rohit looks to sweep but does not get any connection. Called wide.
Spin for the first time today! Adam Zampa is into the attack.
FOUR! Poor bowling from Richardson. He bowls it short and without much pace on middle, Dhawan goes on the back foot and pulls it to the deep square leg for another boundary.
Full and on off, Sharma pushes it to sweeper cover for a run.
Shortish and outside off, Rohit rides the bounce and strokes it straight to covers.
Short and outside off, SD goes back and guides is to fine leg for a single.
Goes wide and outside off on a good length, Rohit runs it down to third man for a single.

A couple of runs! That was not from the middle of the bat though. Richardson bowls it short and outside off, Rohit looks to hammer it over mid-wicket but does not time it well. It goes towards mid-wicket uppishly but bounces well away from the fielder. A couple of runs.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled. Maximum of four fielders can be now stationed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
On the pads, it is worked behind square leg for a single. 55/0 at the end of 10 overs.
Landed around off on a length, it is defended off the back foot.
Length ball angled into Rohit. He gets his bat down in time to work it towards mid-wicket.
Good length ball around off, bounces a bit extra. Rohit keeps it out off his back foot.
Shikhar Dhawan seems to have hurt himself near the rib cage. He is lying on the ground and the physio is out there to have a look at him. Let's hope that he is fine.

Oouch! Dhawan is looking in the pain. That would've hurt. A shortish length ball on the body, Dhawan hops and looks to tuck it around the corner. However, he misses and the ball goes straight into the ribs of Dhawan. He takes the leg bye as the ball goes towards fine leg. But once he reaches at the bowler's end, he goes down on the ground. The umpire has given it as a run.
Full and on the pads, Rohit flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Around off, it is worked towards square leg for a single.
Length ball around off, Richardson rolls his fingers on this one, Rohit reads it well and keeps it out.

Quick single! A full ball on the pads, SD tucks it to the left of the bowler and takes off for a run. Richardson runs after the ball and looks to pick up and throw but he cannot do so. Had he picked the ball and hit the stumps with the throw, Dhawan would've been in trouble. A risky run this.
50 up for the Indians. A ball on the pads of Sharma now, he nudges it towards square leg and takes a single. An excellent start for the Indians.
FOUR! Poor ball and punished! Short and outside off, enough room for Rohit to slash it through cover-point. Once it beats the fielder, the ball races to the fence.
Slightly shortish and around off, Rohit pushes it towards covers.
FOUR! Whipped! Another over that closes with a boundary. Cummins strays on the pads of SD on a fuller length. Dhawan flicks it firmly to the deep square leg fence.
Fullish and around middle, Rohit tucks it to right of the mid-wicket fielder. Before the fielder can get to the ball, both the batters change their ends.
Length and around off, Rohit taps it onto the pitch and thinks of a run but Dhawan is not interested.
Edgy single! A good length ball just outside off, Dhawan looks to drive but the ball takes the outside edge and goes to third man for a single. A slip there would've made things a touch interesting.
Good length ball around off, Dhawan this time pushes it to point.
Full and outside off, Shikhar drives it well but straight to mid off.
Pat Cummins has a change of ends. 3-0-12-0 are his figures so far.

FOUR! Timed it superbly! Richardson bowls it on the pads on a length, Rohit flicks it to deep square leg fence. The short fine leg fielder chases the ball but comes second. 7 from Richardson's first over.
On the pads, SD works it towards mid-wicket and takes a run.
Length ball outside off, Dhawan comes forward and pushes it to mid on.
In the channel outside off, Dhawan initially wanted to play at it but at the last moment pulled his bat away.
Length ball outside off, Rohit guides it towards short third man where the fielder makes a diving stop but a single is taken.
Richardson starts with a length ball on the pads, Dhawan works it in front of square leg for an easy run.
Kane Richardson comes into the attack for the first time today.
A couple to end the over! Slightly shortish ball on middle, Rohit looks to pull but mistimes it towards mid-wicket. Before the fielder can get to the ball, the batters take two.
Good length ball on middle, Rohit looks to pull but misses to get hit high on the pads.

Dropped! A tough chance for Smith though. A short ball outside off, Rohit cuts it towards point uppishly. Smith there dives to his right and tries to catch with his one hand. The ball hits his hand and goes behind. A couple of runs taken.
Full and around off again, RS pushes it towards covers.
FOUR! Glorious! Full and around off from Starc, Rohit leans into the shot and times it brilliantly. It races to the fence through the covers.
WIDE! Stars errs his line and bowls it down the leg side. Rohit looks to flick but misses. Wided by the umpire.
Back of a length ball around off, it is defended.

Overthrow! Full and on middle, Dhawan pushes it towards mid on and takes a run. Richardson from mid on picks the ball and has a shy at the batter's end. He hits the stumps and the ball goes to fine leg and an overthrow has been conceded. Needless.
Beaten! Nicely shaped away with the angle. Cummins pitches it just behind good length and outside off, Dhawan looks to push it towards the off side but misses.
Landed on a length around off, Dhawan looks to cut but ends up chopping it on the off side.
Shortish length ball from Cummins. It is angled away from the left-hander. Dhawan without any feet movement looks to cut but misses.
Length ball angled into the batter, Rohit tucks it towards deep square leg for a run.
Loose shot! A good length ball outside off, Rohit looks to pull but misses as the ball keeps a touch low.
Full and around off, Dhawan pushes it towards covers.

FOUR! Flicked away! Starc misses his line and bowls it full on the pads, Dhawan easily flicks it to fine leg. The fielder is there and he moves across and then sticks his right hand to stop the ball but he cannot do so and the ball eventually goes to the fence.
Around off on a good length, Dhawan looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

Excellent effort in the deep from Cummins! A short ball outside off from Starc, Dhawan slashes it through point. Cummins from third man runs across and makes a diving stop. A couple of runs for Dhawan.
Low full toss just outside off, Dhawan looks to drive it towards the off side but the ball takes the inner half of the bat and goes to mid on.
Shortish length ball around off, Shikhar rides the bounce and taps it towards point.
Length ball on the pads, it is worked towards short fine leg. So, after a maiden, Cummins bowls a 9-run over.

FOUR! Rohit gets off the mark now and in some style! Cummins sprays on the pads of Rohit. Sharma needs no another invitation as he flicks it to deep square leg fence, No chance for the fine leg fielder to cut it off.
Length ball on the pads, Shikhar nudges it behind square to take a single.
In the channel outside off on a shortish length, Dhawan watchfully lets it go to the keeper.
FOUR! This time he finds the gap through the off side. Cummins goes full and gives room outside off, Shikhar slams it past the diving cover fielder. It races to the fence in a jiffy.
Cummins bowls his first ball to the left-hander and delivers it fuller and around off, SD strokes it well but straight to mid off.
Full and on the pads, Shikhar flicks it nicely but straight to fine leg, so just a single. 5 from Starc's first over.
Goes wide on a slightly fuller length, Dhawan though throws his bat at the ball without any feet movement. He does not make any connection though.
Good length ball around off, this comes back in a hint as Dhawan looks to work it towards the leg side but misses to get hit high on the pads.
Fuller and on middle, Dhawan pushes it to mid on.
Good length and on middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Dhawan is off the mark in style and India open their account too. Timed it brilliantly. A fuller length ball around off, Dhawan leans into the drive and strokes it past the bowler and into the long off fence.
Mitchell Starc will bowl with the second new ball from the other end.

Goes full and around off and middle, Rohit looks to defend but the ball takes the outer half of the bat and goes to covers. A maiden to start the innings. Excellent stuff from Cummins, hardly any movement in the over though.
A good length ball around off, Rohit this time stays on the back foot and taps it onto the pitch on the off side. Good tight lines these from Cummins so far. Can he finish  it well?
Fullish and around middle and leg, Rohit pushes it towards mid on.
This time bowls it slightly fuller and just outside off, Rohit comes forward and pushes it towards covers.
Another ball on the stumps line, Rohit easily nudges it towards mid-wicket.
Cummins starts with a good length ball and angles it into the pads. Rohit brings his bat down in time to turn it towards square leg.
We are all set to get underway!!! Rohit Sharma and Shikhar Dhawan are making their way out to the middle followed by the Australian players. Pat Cummins will start the proceedings for the visitors.

India (Playing XI) - Rohit Sharma, Shikhar Dhawan, KL Rahul (WK), Virat Kohli (C), Shreyas Iyer, Manish Pandey (In place of Rishabh Pant), Ravindra Jadeja, Navdeep Saini (In place of Shardul Thakur), Kuldeep Yadav, Mohammed Shami, Jasprit Bumrah.

Australia (Unchanged playing XI) - David Warner, Aaron Finch (C), Marnus Labuschagne, Steven Smith, Ashton Turner, Alex Carey (WK), Ashton Agar, Pat Cummins, Mitchell Starc, Kane Richardson, Adam Zampa.

Virat Kohli, the Indian skipper, says that they also would've bowled first. Tells that hopefully there won't be a lot of dew but feels that it might come after 8.30-9.00 PM. Says that they will try to put a decent total and put the opposition under pressure. Adds that they will look to forget the last game and tells that one can expect one team to get beaten against sides like Australia. Believes that they have beaten the Aussies earlier and they will look to bounce back in the game. On the playing XI, Kohli says that Pant is out due to a concussion and Manish Pandey replaces him while Navdeep Saini comes in to replace Shardul Thakur.

Aaron Finch, the Aussie skipper, says that it is a beautiful wicket and it will remain the same throughout the game. Tells that they chased in the last game and they will not change the template. Says that the spinners bowled really well as they got their lengths right. Reveals that they are going with the same XI.
TOSS - Virat Kohli flips the coin and it lands in the favour of Aaron Finch. AUSTRALIA WILL BOWL FIRST.

India. Defeated comprehensively? That too at home? Yes, that's what happened in the first ODI as Australia beat the hosts by 10 wickets. India though are too strong a team to not bounce back and the visitors would be surely expecting that. Lot of things to look forward to for India. Where will Kohli bat? Who will replace Rishabh Pant? Srikar Bharat has been named as the back-up wicket-keeper but is unlikely to slot in the playing XI. Australia, on the other hand, are unlikely to make any changes to their playing XI. What will happen? Will the Men in Blue make a comeback or will the visitors take an unassailable lead in the series?
